speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you've been experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To help narrow down the cause, can you tell me if you have noticed any changes in your urinary habits, such as frequency, urgency, or burning sensation?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any pain or burning when you urinate, and have you noticed any changes in the color or clarity of your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any joint pain, abdominal pain, or swelling along with the rash while taking cephalexin? I suspect we may be dealing with a drug-induced interstitial nephritis given the recent antibiotic exposure and current symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of antibiotic use, rash, and current fever with flank pain, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis_and_Urine_Electrolytes
